focus: Operator Dispatch, Sanand Fleet Diagnostics, Spares Clearance & Mandatory Leave Policy

breakdowns.site: Sanand Site (Supervisor Pravesh) — Blue Star Scissor Lift Fleet
breakdowns.issue: Actuator coil burnt out on-site and replaced; recurring starting trouble and battery discharging repeatedly every other day. Operator absent due to monsoon fever, forcing supervisor to manually haul oil and operate machines without notifying Imran.
breakdowns.action: Imran Khan deploying replacement operator immediately. Direct escalation protocol enforced: supervisors strictly instructed to call or WhatsApp Imran immediately rather than running machines unassisted. Pravesh to log battery diagnostics before requesting new battery pack.
breakdowns.status: Operator Dispatched; Direct Communication Protocol Enforced

breakdowns.site: Sanand Site — JCB 3246 Scissor Lift (Serial No. 5710, 2-Month Old Machine)
breakdowns.issue: Machine standing idle in breakdown for 2–3 days due to electrical wiring harness failure.
breakdowns.action: Direct warranty claim escalated to JCB OEM by Sushil Mishra. JCB technical team verified wiring harness is inherently OK and advised inspecting for a localized pinch or short circuit. Pardeep Tomar inspecting on site today to trace and isolate electrical short.
breakdowns.status: Under JCB Warranty Support; On-Site Short-Circuit Inspection Underway

breakdowns.site: Dulhera Site (CG Power Client) — 12-Meter Scissor Lift & Fleet Tyres
breakdowns.issue: Tyres sold to CG Power arrived on site; 12-meter scissor lift has operational function defects requiring technician troubleshooting.
breakdowns.action: Imran Khan mobilizing mechanic urgently to Dulhera to execute tyre fitment and diagnose 12m scissor functionality. Commercial invoicing to be coordinated by Pardeep Tomar.
breakdowns.status: Mechanic Dispatched; Tyre Fitment & Function Diagnostics Active

breakdowns.site: Sanand Site (Tata Micron) — Zoomlion / 600 Scissor Lift
breakdowns.issue: Newly installed local charger producing loud humming/buzzing noise ('bhann-bhann') and failing to charge the machine (achieved only 2% charge over entire overnight cycle), triggering severe client escalation.
breakdowns.action: Pandit Dhiraj Dubey escalated urgency. Jitendra Budhauliya instructed immediate inspection and replacement of the defective local charger unit.
breakdowns.status: Critical Client Escalation; Replacement Charger Sourcing Underway

breakdowns.site: Sanand Site (Tata Micron) — JCB 2646 & JCB 3246 Scissor Lifts
breakdowns.issue: Severe battery discharge failure where machines cut off completely upon reaching 50% capacity. Machines are 2024 models with lapsed battery warranties.
breakdowns.action: Jitendra Budhauliya and Pardeep Tomar mandated that Deepak and site team must submit multi-meter cell voltage load test reports and log Google Form tickets before replacement battery packs are approved.
breakdowns.status: Diagnostic Reports Required; Formal Google Form Logging Pending

breakdowns.issue: Hydraulic oil leakage from the hydraulic tank beneath the coil/valve block; unit being operated with low hydraulic oil level risking pump cavitation and permanent burnout.
breakdowns.action: Video footage verified. Technician instructed to cease operation or top up hydraulic oil immediately, inspect seals, and replace leaking hydraulic line.
breakdowns.status: Video Verified; Immediate Hydraulic Hose/Seal Rectification Ordered

parts.statusNextSteps: Mundra urgently requires 2 replacement batteries. Central store lacks stock, but 6 surplus good-condition batteries are available at Sanand from a prior 8-unit replacement batch. Pardeep authorized to transfer required battery directly from Sanand to Mundra immediately.

Pardeep confirmed 1 JCB and 2 Zoomlion tyres ready for local dispatch. For 2x 45ft tyres coming from Pune: voucher prepared on 13th August; Jitendra Budhauliya expediting payment clearance upon receiving file number from Vinay Singh to authorize immediate vendor dispatch.

parts.part: Repaired Hydraulic Pump & Electric Drive Motor
parts.statusNextSteps: Overhaul completed. Jitendra Budhauliya mandated comprehensive pressure and operational bench testing this morning prior to authorizing dispatch at 3:00 PM today.

parts.context: Zoomlion / 600 Unit — Tata Micron Site, Sanand
parts.statusNextSteps: Defective buzzing local charger (2% overnight charge) to be replaced immediately with tested OEM/industrial-grade charger unit.
Software pendrive and diagnostic connection cable dispatched to Sanand for calibration and controller diagnostics.

directives.title: Mandatory Overtime (OT) WhatsApp Group for Leave Requests & Attendance
points: All 40–45 field mechanics, technicians, and supervisors must submit leave applications EXCLUSIVELY in the official Overtime WhatsApp group (designated due to lower chat traffic).

Strict Prohibition of Personal Approvals: Neither Jitendra Budhauliya nor Sushil Mishra will accept or approve leaves communicated via personal WhatsApp chats, 1-on-1 direct messages, or verbal calls.

Double Leave Deduction Penalty: Any technician taking unannounced leave without prior notification in the designated OT group will be marked as Unauthorized Absence (Absent) with a mandatory 2-day leave penalty deducted from their record.

directives.title: Zero-Tolerance Google Form Prerequisite for Spare Parts Dispatch
points: Store Manager Pardeep Tomar will NOT dispatch any spare parts, tyres, or battery packs based solely on phone calls, verbal requests, or informal WhatsApp messages.
All parts requisitions must be formally logged into the company Google Form with machine serial numbers, fault description, and cell load diagnostic reports.

directives.title: Supervisor-to-Coordinator Direct Escalation Protocol
points: Site supervisors (such as Pravesh) must not attempt to perform manual machine operation or heavy parts hauling alone during operator shortages.
Supervisors must call or WhatsApp Imran Khan immediately upon discovering absent operators. Relief operators or helpers will be mobilized within 1–2 hours.

directives.title: Sanand Site Technical Manpower Expansion
points: Due to high fleet density (both boom and scissor lifts) at Sanand, technician Deepak is overburdened with solo calibrations, TPIs, and multi-site travel. Pardeep Tomar is deploying to Sanand tomorrow to assist with calibration, and management is recruiting an additional dedicated scissor lift technician for the region.

actionItems.task: Obtain file number from Vinay Singh to immediately clear pending 13th August payment for 45ft Pune tyres; oversee mandatory bench testing of repaired pump and motor before 3:00 PM dispatch; enforce OT group leave notification rule and penalize unapproved absences.

Mobilize dedicated replacement operator to Pravesh's site immediately; dispatch mechanic to Dulhera site for urgent tyre fitment and 12m scissor troubleshooting; maintain direct proactive contact with field supervisors.

Liaise with JCB OEM technical team on JCB 3246 (Unit 5710) wiring harness short circuit diagnosis; enforce strict refusal of personal 1-on-1 leave approvals; coordinate technical handover of warranty tyres at CG Power Dulhera.

Coordinate transfer of replacement battery from Sanand's 6-unit surplus stock to fulfill Mundra site requirement; travel to Sanand tomorrow to support Deepak with machine calibration and TPI clearances; ensure zero parts dispatch without Google Form verification.

Replace defective buzzing local charger at Sanand (unit achieved only 2% charge overnight); instruct technician Deepak to log full cell voltage load tests on degraded 50% cutoff batteries into Google Form.

Forward Pune tyre supplier invoice file number (dated 13th August) to Jitendra Budhauliya for instant payment execution; finalize candidate recruitment for additional scissor lift technician at Sanand.
Board scheduled train to Chennai with confirmed travel ticket to execute urgent machine breakdown repairs on site.
